sources.title: Koudelka et al. 2025 · Supplementary Table S5 · Direct MSF
PXD055927 submitted human canonical FASTA (exploratory specificity mapping)

identification_scope: Peptide rows in S5 and unique modified-sequence/charge identities expanded from its charge column; not verified as the full identification universe.
cv_method: Previously calculated from S5 peptide quantities: sample SD/mean over three biological replicates per dose, pooled across eight doses. All source rows had positive quantities across 24 runs.

specificity.method: Prior exploratory FASTA mapping: specific if both termini match Trypsin/P boundaries; semi-specific if exactly one matches. Protein termini included, initiator methionine excision and processed termini not modeled. Multi-mapping uses specific before semi-specific before non-specific. Two-sided nonspecific and unmapped identities excluded from the pie. Not a harmonized final classification.

caveats: This workflow is FragPipe/MSFragger identification plus DIA-NN quantification, not standalone DIA-NN.
Values were manually transcribed from the prior local analysis; this export does not reparse S5.
Source-table coverage is not equivalent to all FDR-filtered SynapSpec identifications.
CV cohorts differ between tools; upstream normalization, selection and imputation have not been harmonized.
Specificity is provisional and uses a different classification method from SynapSpec.
